summary: The lightweight version of the Orbit, built on North's N-u80 airframe (100% ultra-PE fiber with Technora reinforcement) rather than Aluula. Thinner leading edge and struts, a six-point bridle and slightly higher aspect than the standard Orbit, in in-between sizes like 7.3 and 8.1m.
best_for: Competitive big air riders chasing maximum height and lighter-weight feel
